mapper.select: SELECT account.code AS "accountCode", account.name AS "accountName", currency.currency_code AS "currency", -SUM(line.quantity) AS "amount" FROM journal_entry_line line JOIN register register ON register.register_id = line.register_id JOIN register_type register_type ON register_type.register_type_id = register.register_type_id AND register_type.register_type_code = 'TAX_PAYABLE' JOIN account account ON account.account_id = register.account_id JOIN account_type account_type ON account_type.account_type_id = account.account_type_id AND account_type.code = 'TAX_AUTHORITY' JOIN currency currency ON currency.currency_id = line.currency_id GROUP BY account.code, account.name, currency.currency_code ORDER BY account.code, currency.currency_code
mapper.sql: SELECT account.code AS "accountCode", account.name AS "accountName", currency.currency_code AS "currency", -SUM(line.quantity) AS "amount" FROM journal_entry_line line JOIN register register ON register.register_id = line.register_id JOIN register_type register_type ON register_type.register_type_id = register.register_type_id AND register_type.register_type_code = 'MERCHANT_PAYABLE' JOIN account account ON account.account_id = register.account_id JOIN account_type account_type ON account_type.account_type_id = account.account_type_id AND account_type.code = 'MERCHANT' JOIN currency currency ON currency.currency_id = line.currency_id
mapper.select: GROUP BY account.code, account.name, currency.currency_code ORDER BY account.code, currency.currency_code
